currentContext.business: Incorporated on March 10, 1993 as Flora Textiles Limited under the Registrar of Companies, Coimbatore, the Company operated for over three decades in the trading and job manufacturing of yarn and fabric before being renamed Anirit Ventures Limited with effect from December 20, 2024 following the Oilmax Energy acquisition. currentContext.expansion: Anirit Ventures discloses no plant, capacity addition, commissioning or ramp-up programme in FY 2025-26; expansion in this year was corporate rather than physical. Following Oilmax Energy Private Limited taking control, the Company repositioned itself out of the erstwhile yarn and fabric trading business and spent the year evaluating and assembling a platform in sustainability-driven ventures, agriculture and allied activities, green technologies and innovation-led projects. The two concrete expansion actions were a Rights Issue to existing eligible shareholders, completed during FY 2025-26 to finance identified business objectives and long-term strategic initiatives, and the acquisition of Anirit Agritech Private Limited, a Controlled Environment Agriculture company, which became a subsidiary and is the Company's entry into technology-driven, climate-controlled farming. Forward expansion intent is stated only as direction, without sites, capacities, costs or dates: an integrated biomass-to-energy value chain running from captive feedstock cultivation and CBG to biofuels, gasification-based power and, in the near future, hydrogen, to be built by leveraging Oilmax group synergies in EPC, O&M, offtake and R&D and JVs with global biogas and biofuel leaders; and an innovation portfolio in Passive Radiative Cooling, Phase Change Materials and energy-efficient green coatings developed with institutions such as IIT Bombay, to be scaled through partnerships, M&A and joint ventures. Consistent with the absence of any project under execution, the accounts record capital commitments of Nil at both 31st March 2026 and 31st March 2025.
